features: DISPLAY: The massive 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display features up to 1600nits of peak brightness, an ultra-slim 5.2 mm bezel and Seamless Vision Booster for a clear picture even in the sun. COLOR & DESIGN: Just 5.1mm thin and 692g light, Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra pairs a large, bright display with asleek design. It's available in two classy colorways, Gray and Silver, with the hexagon-shaped S Pen included.

RAM & STORAGE: The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra offers ample memory and storage capacity. With up to 12GB of memory and 512GB of storage, it enables fast, seamless multitasking and support for large files. If needed, you can even expand storage up to 2 TB with a microSD card.

CONNECTIVITY: Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth v6 keep you latency-free in competitive lobbies; USB 3.2 Gen 1 for rapid file transfers. UNIQUE FEATURE: Experience pro-grade creativity with Adobe Photoshop, now on Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. Enjoy a spacious canvas, S Pen support and low-latency responsiveness for smooth editing.

SPEAKERS & AUDIO: The Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra features Dolby engineered Quad Speakers that deliver a rich, multidimensional audio experience. From your favorite playlists to the latest movies, the immersive 3D sound draws you into a soundscape that’s crisp, clear, and deeply engaging.

AI CAPABILITIES: Use Note Assist to generate useful note summaries and review key points quickly. Simply tap the Galaxy AI button in the Samsung Notes app and select Summarize to turn lengthy notes into a concise overview. Upload PDFs, websites, images and voice recordings to Gemini Notebook, then askquestions to get relevant answers and insights. Or turn your sources into flashcards, videos, slide decks, quizzes and more.
